Responsible for deploying and supporting middleware applications using Oracle WebLogic products. The ideal candidate will have a minimum 5 years of experience with middleware administration in a large enterprise environment with a focus on WebLogic.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
ESPECIALISTA DEVOPS

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos um Especialista DevOps, que não apenas domine as ferramentas e práticas de automação, mas que tenha um profundo entendimento de que cada linha de código e cada processo de pipeline impacta diretamente na nossa postura de segurança. Você não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas um(a) parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na evolução da nossa infraestrutura, garantindo que a inovação e a segurança caminhem lado a lado.



Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e Manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible para provisionar, configurar e gerenciar nossa infraestrutura em ambientes multi-cloud (Huawei, Azure, GCP), garantindo que todos os recursos sejam versionados e auditáveis.
  • Orquestração e Gerenciamento de Contêineres: Projetar, implementar e sustentar clusters Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) robustos e seguros, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de aplicações conteinerizadas.
  • Automação de Pipelines CI/CD: Criar e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com AzureDevOps, GitLab CI ou ferramenta similar, integrando etapas de análise de segurança estática (SAST), dinâmica (DAST) e de composição de software (SCA) diretamente no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitoramento, Observabilidade e Resposta a Incidentes: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) para garantir a saúde, performance e segurança dos nossos serviços. Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de anomalias e ser peça-chave na resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Fortalecer a Cultura DevSecOps: Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para disseminar as melhores práticas de \"security by design\". Você será um evangelizador da segurança em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Gerenciamento de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Analisar o consumo de recursos na nuvem e propor otimizações contínuas para garantir a eficiência de custos sem comprometer a performance e a segurança.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Sólida Experiência (mínimo de 5 anos) em DevOps/SRE: Vivência comprovada em ambientes de produção de alta criticidade.
  • Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Expertise em Orquestração de Contêineres: Experiência prática e aprofundada com Kubernetes e Docker em produção.
  • Mestria em Automação de CI/CD: Amplo conhecimento na construção e manutenção de pipelines com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, ou Azure DevOps.
  • Scripting e Automação: Fluência em linguagens como Python, Go ou Bash.
  • Conhecimento em Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência significativa com pelo menos um dos grandes provedores (Huawei, Azure ou GCP).
  • Mentalidade de Segurança: Conhecimento prático sobre os princípios de segurança em nuvem, redes e aplicações.

O que seria muito legal se você soubesse:

  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) ou em Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) são um grande diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST, e segurança de contêineres (Aqua Security, Trivy).
  • Experiência em empresas que seguem padrões como ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI-DSS.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.

The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).

No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.


No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.


A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

e sustentável.

  • técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis

  • regulamentadoras e especificações internas.

  • a confiabilidade dos ativos

  • e inspeção.

  • mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.

  • envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.

title: UI/UX Designer

UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.


We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.g., , job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM ESTATÍSTICA E DADOS
description:
Company Description

A XMX Corp é uma empresa de performance digital focada em escalar funis de vendas com base em dados e resultados reais.   • Aplicar métodos estatísticos avançados para análise de performance (funil, ofertas, backend, retenção, reembolso, churn);
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos para:
  • Projeção de receita
  • Probabilidade de recompra
  • Tendência de reembolso
  • Lifetime Value (LTV)
  • Elasticidade de preço
  • Analisar experimentos e testes A/B com rigor estatístico
  • Criar modelos de atribuição e correlação entre variáveis de negócio;
  • Elevar o nível de confiabilidade dos dados e análises da empresa;
  • Identificar vieses, inconsistências e distorções nos dados;
  • Construir dashboards estratégicos com foco em tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar diretoria na interpretação estatística de cenários e projeções;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Funil, Backend, Financeiro e Oferta para traduzir dados em estratégias práticas.
  • Organização de todos os testes que estão sendo feitos na empresa, documentação e análise.
QUALIFICAÇÕES:
  • Formação sólida em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de estatística descritiva e inferencial;
  • Conhecimento profundo em:
  • Probabilidade
  • Regressão
  • Testes de hipótese
  • Modelagem preditiva
  • Séries temporais
  • Análise multivariada
  • Experiência com análise de experimentos (A/B testing);
  • Experiência com grandes bases de dados;
  • Capacidade de traduzir análises complexas em decisões claras para o negócio.
  • Diferencial :
  • Conhecimento em Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels ou similares); 
  • Conhecimento em SQL;
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta velocidade (startup ou digital).
  • Experiência com marketing digital ou e-commerce;
COMPETÊNCIAS:
  • RIGOR ANALÍTICO
  • PENSAMENTO LÓGICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • PRECISÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE SIMPLIFICAR O COMPLEXO
  • PROATIVIDADE
SALÁRIO:

TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office
COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;

O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer (PHP/Angular)
description:

This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions.

The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

  • Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments

  • Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

Mais sobre nós:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.


Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.


Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.


Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.


Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.


Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.

Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.

Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).

Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.

Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.

Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.

Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).

Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.

Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.

Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.

Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.

Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.

Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.

Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.

Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.

Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).

Experiência com Java ou Scala.

Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.


Requisitos e qualificações

APIs REST e JSON

Git (controle de código e versionamento)

Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados


Soft Skills e Competências Comportamentais:
